source:
• 你试图安抚一头施法距离内你能看见的野兽，目标野兽必须成功通过一次感知豁免，否则将在法术持续时间内被你魅惑。若它正与你或你的友方生物战斗，则其进行该豁免时具有优势。
• 该野兽被魅惑时，只要你与其处于同一位面就可以与之保持心灵感应。你在有意识时，可以通过心灵感应命令该生物（不需要作动作），而它则会尽量服从。你可以描述一个简单具体的行为指令，比如“攻击那个生物”“跑到那个位置”或是“去拿那个物品”。生物完成一项指令却未收到你的进一步指示时，将会使用其本身的能力尽可能的保护自己。
• 你可以使用动作以彻底而精确的控制目标。而该生物则只能作你选择的动作，且不能作任何你没有允许的动作，并持续至你下回合结束。在此期间，你还可以要求该生物作一个反应，但这需要你使用自己的反应来实现。
• 每次目标受到伤害时，都可以尝试进行一次感知豁免，豁免成功则法术终止。
• 升环施法效应：使用5环法术位施展该法术时，持续时间变为：专注，至多10分钟。使用6环法术位施展该法术时，持续时间变为：专注，至多1 小时。使用7环或更高法术位施展该法术时，持续时间变为：专注，至多8小时。
target:
• You attempt to subdue a beast you can see within range. The beast must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. If it is fighting you or your allies, it has advantage on this saving throw.
• While the beast is charmed, you have a telepathic link with it as long as you are on the same plane of existence. While conscious, you can use this link to give the creature commands (no action required), which it does its best to obey. You can specify a simple, concrete course of action, such as "Attack that creature," "Run to that location," or "Fetch that object." If the creature completes an instruction without receiving further directions, it uses its own abilities to protect itself as well as it can.
• You can use your action to take total and precise control of the target. Until the end of your next turn, the creature takes only the actions you choose and takes no actions you have not permitted. During this time, you can also make the creature use a reaction, but you must use your own reaction to do so.
• Each time the target takes damage, it can attempt a Wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a level 5 spell slot, its duration becomes Concentration, up to 10 minutes. Using a level 6 spell slot makes its duration Concentration, up to 1 hour. Using a level 7 or higher spell slot makes its duration Concentration, up to 8 hours.
note: Full source retained, including the target's optional saving throw on each instance of damage, precise-control duration, and all three higher-slot durations.

source:
• 指定施法距离内至多一个你能看见的生物，选择下述伤害类型之一：强酸，冷冻，火焰，闪电或雷鸣，并迫使目标进行一次体质豁免检定。豁免失败者直至法术终止前，每回合第一次受到选定类型的伤害时，目标额外受到2d6点对应类型的伤害。此外，直到法术终止，该目标失去对该伤害类型的任何抗性。
• 升环施法效应：使用5环或更高法术位施放该法术时，你使用的法术位每比4环高一环，就能多指定一个目标。而各目标之间距离不能超过30尺。
context: column:M;spell:Elemental Bane;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:4
target:
• Choose up to one creature you can see within range and one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. Force the target to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, until the spell ends, the first time each turn that the target takes damage of the chosen type, it takes an extra 2d6 damage of that type. In addition, the target loses any resistance to that damage type until the spell ends.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a level 5 or higher spell slot, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 4. The targets must be within 30 feet of one another.
note: Retains the once-per-turn first-damage trigger and loss of resistance; no immunity removal is added.

source:
• 你指定一处施法距离内你能看见的20尺方形区域，使其内布满蠕动的乌黑触须，进而使该区域成为困难地形。
• 任何生物在一个回合内第一次进入该区域，或者在区域内开始其回合时，必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败者将受到3d6点钝击伤害，并且被触须束缚直至法术终止。生物在区域内开始其回合时，如果已受触须束缚则受到3d6点钝击伤害。
• 受触须束缚的生物可以使用动作进行一次对抗法术豁免DC的力量检定或敏捷检定（自选其一），检定成功则挣脱束缚。
target:
• Choose a 20-foot-square area you can see within range. Writhing black tentacles fill it, making the area difficult terrain.
• When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage and is restrained by the tentacles until the spell ends. A creature that starts its turn in the area while already restrained by the tentacles takes 3d6 bludgeoning damage.
• A creature restrained by the tentacles can use its action to make a Strength check or a Dexterity check (its choice) against your spell save DC. On a success, it frees itself.
note: Preserves the separate automatic damage for an already restrained creature and the action-based choice of escape check.

source:
• 你将一种原材料转化成该材料制作的成品。例如，你可以将一丛树木转化为一座木桥，一把麻草化为绳子，或是将亚麻和羊毛化作衣物。
• 指定施法距离内你能看见的原材料。只要有足够的材料，你就可以将他们转化为一件大型或更小的物件（至多占据10尺立方区域或八个相邻的5尺立方区域）。如果你的目标材料是金属、石料或者其他矿石材料，那么被制造的物件不能大于中型（至多占据5尺立方区域），制成品的质量和原材料质量相同。
• 生物或魔法物品不能作为该法术的原料或成品。你只有对制作某物品的工匠工具拥有熟练项时，才能使用该法术制作相应需要高工艺水平制作的物品，如珠宝、武器、玻璃、护甲等。
target:
• You turn raw material of one kind into a finished product made of that material. For example, you can turn a stand of trees into a wooden bridge, a bundle of hemp into rope, or flax and wool into clothing.
• Choose raw materials you can see within range. If sufficient material is available, you can turn it into a Large or smaller object, occupying no more than a 10-foot cube or eight connected 5-foot cubes. If the material is metal, stone, or another mineral, the object you create can be no larger than Medium, occupying no more than a 5-foot cube. The finished product has the same quality as its raw materials.
• Creatures and magic items cannot be used as the spell's raw materials or created as its products. To create an item that requires a high degree of craftsmanship, such as jewelry, weapons, glass, or armor, you must be proficient with the artisan's tools used to make that item.
note: All material, size, quality, and proficiency restrictions are retained; the connected-cube alternative is not omitted.

source:
• 你召唤一个圣魂并呈现出忠诚的、雄伟的坐骑外观。坐骑显现在施法距离内未被占据的空间，其外形由你从以下形态中选择：狮鹫Griffon、飞马Pegasus、鹿鹰兽Peryton、恐狼Dire Wolf、犀牛Rhinoceros或者剑齿虎Saber-toothed Tiger（DM也可以允许你选择其他动物作坐骑）。坐骑拥有你所选形态的属性数据，但他实际上属于天界生物，精类生物或邪魔的一种（由你选择）而不是通常类型。另外，如果你的坐骑智力为5或更低，则其智力变为6，同时能听懂一门你掌握的语言。
• 不管是否在战斗中，坐骑都能为你提供帮助，而你们之间的契约让你们行动更为紧密。你乘上该坐骑时，所有你施展的只以自身为目标的法术同时也影响该坐骑。
• 该坐骑生命值降至0时消失不见，且不留下任何物质残余。你也可以随时用一个动作解散该坐骑使其消失。此后，每当你重新施展该法术时，将满生命值的召唤同一匹坐骑显现。
• 坐骑在你身边1里内时，你可以与其以心灵感应的方式进行交流。
• 你不能用该法术同时拥有一匹以上的坐骑，你可以随时用一个动作将坐骑从契约中解放，并使其消失不见。
context: column:M;spell:Find Greater Steed;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:4
target:
• You summon a holy spirit that takes the form of a loyal, magnificent mount. It appears in an unoccupied space within range in one of the following forms of your choice: Griffon, Pegasus, Peryton, Dire Wolf, Rhinoceros, or Saber-toothed Tiger. The DM may also allow another animal as a mount. The mount uses the statistics of the chosen form, but its type is Celestial, Fey, or Fiend (your choice) instead of its usual type. In addition, if its Intelligence is 5 or lower, its Intelligence becomes 6, and it understands one language you speak.
• The mount assists you both in and out of combat, and your bond lets you act in close coordination. While you are mounted on it, every spell you cast that targets only yourself also affects the mount.
• When the mount drops to 0 hit points, it disappears, leaving no physical remains. You can also dismiss it at any time as an action, causing it to disappear. Each subsequent time you cast this spell, you summon the same mount at full hit points.
• While the mount is within 1 li of you, you can communicate with it telepathically.
• You cannot have more than one mount from this spell at a time. You can release the mount from its bond at any time as an action, causing it to disappear.
note: The source uses bare li for the telepathic distance, not an explicit mile; retained as li pending unit review. The source's holy-spirit description and self-targeted spell sharing are retained without adding restrictions from another version.

source:
• 轻薄缥缈的火焰在法术持续期间环绕着你的身体，散发出10尺半径的明亮光照和再延伸10尺的微光光照。你可以借由使用一个动作解消它以提早结束此法术。
• 这层火焰可以提供你温暖的护盾或寒冷的护盾，由你选择。温暖的护盾将赋予你对冷冻伤害的抗性，而寒冷的护盾则会赋予你对火焰伤害的抗性。
• 此外，每当一个距离你5尺内的生物以一次近战攻击命中你，这个护盾将迸发出火焰。攻击者将受到来自温暖护盾的2d8火焰伤害，或来自寒冷护盾的2d8冷冻伤害。
target:
• Thin, wispy flames surround your body for the duration, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. You can dismiss the spell early as an action.
• The flames provide a warm shield or a chill shield, your choice. A warm shield grants you resistance to cold damage, and a chill shield grants you resistance to fire damage.
• In addition, whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, the shield erupts in flames. The attacker takes 2d8 fire damage from a warm shield or 2d8 cold damage from a chill shield.
note: Retains the distinct illumination radii, opposite-type resistances, and damage on a nearby attack that hits.

source:
• 你触碰一个自愿生物，并使目标在法术持续时间内移动时不受困难地形限制，并使任何降低目标速度，或者使目标陷入麻痹或束缚的法术或魔法效应对其无法生效。
• 该目标还可以花费5尺移动力直接从非魔法的束缚中挣脱（诸如镣铐或生物的擒抱等）。此外，目标在水下进行移动和攻击时不再受减益规则的限制。
target:
• You touch a willing creature. For the duration, the target's movement is unaffected by difficult terrain, and spells or magical effects that reduce its speed or cause it to be paralyzed or restrained have no effect on it.
• The target can also spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape nonmagical restraints, such as manacles or a creature's grapple. In addition, being underwater imposes no penalties on the target's movement or attacks.
note: The broad source wording about effects that reduce speed or impose conditions is retained; no new action cost is added to escaping nonmagical restraints.

source:
• 你指定施法距离内至多十只蜈蚣，或三只蜘蛛，或五只黄蜂，或一只蝎子作为法术目标，在法术持续时间内你将其转化为它们自然形态的巨大版本。蜈蚣变成巨型蜈蚣，蜘蛛变成巨型蜘蛛，黄蜂变成巨型黄蜂，蝎子变成巨型蝎子。
• 每只生物都将服从你的口头命令。在战斗中，它们每轮在你的回合行动。这些生物的属性数据及其动作选项和移动能力均由DM掌控。
• 在法术持续时间内，目标生物将维持其巨大的体型，直到其生命值降至0或你用一个动作解除其身上的效应为止。DM可能会允许你指定不同的生物作为法术目标。例如，如果你转化一只蜜蜂，则其巨大版本可能会使用与巨黄蜂一样的属性数据。
target:
• Choose up to ten centipedes, three spiders, five wasps, or one scorpion within range. For the duration, you transform them into giant versions of their natural forms: centipedes become giant centipedes, spiders become giant spiders, wasps become giant wasps, and a scorpion becomes a giant scorpion.
• Each creature obeys your verbal commands. In combat, they act on your turn each round. The DM controls their statistics, action options, and movement capabilities.
• A target maintains its giant form for the duration, until it drops to 0 hit points, or until you use an action to end the effect on it. The DM might allow different creatures as targets. For example, a bee you transform might use the statistics of a giant wasp for its giant form.
note: All four alternative creature quantities and the DM's example remain; written-out source quantities are also written out in English.

source:
• 你指定施法距离内一个你能够看见的未被占据空间，并召唤一条藤蔓使其从该空间的地面上破土而出。施展该法术时，你可以指使该藤蔓抽拉其30尺范围内一个你能看见的生物。该生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败则被往藤蔓所在方向拉近20尺。
• 直至该法术终止前，你可以在你的回合里用一个附赠动作指使藤蔓抽拉同一生物或者转向抽拉另一个生物。
target:
• Choose an unoccupied space you can see within range. You conjure a vine that sprouts from the ground there. When you cast the spell, you can direct the vine to lash at a creature you can see within 30 feet of it. That creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it is pulled 20 feet toward the vine.
• Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on your turn to direct the vine to lash at the same creature or at another one.
note: The initial cast instruction and subsequent bonus-action instructions remain distinct; the pull occurs only on a failed save.

source:
• 一道半径20尺球形范围的破坏性能量在施法距离内你能看见的一点为源点形成，并开始拖拽范围内的生物。所有在范围内的生物必须进行一次体质豁免检定。若豁免失败，该生物受到5d10点力场伤害并且会被直直拉向能量的中心，并在离中心尽可能近的未被占据的空间停止（哪怕这会让他飞到天上）。若豁免成功，则其受到一半伤害并且不会被拉走。
• 升环施法效应：当你使用5环或者更高环位的法术位施展该法术时，每比4环高出一环的法术位可以使该法术的伤害增加1d10。
target:
• A sphere of destructive energy with a 20-foot radius forms around a point you can see within range and begins pulling at creatures in the area. Each creature in the area must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 5d10 force damage and is pulled directly toward the energy's center, stopping in the nearest possible unoccupied space to that center, even if this carries it into the air. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and is not pulled.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a level 5 or higher spell slot, its damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 4.
note: The destination is the nearest possible unoccupied space to the center, including an airborne one; no pull occurs on a successful save.

source:
• 一个大型的幽灵守护者出现在施法距离内一个你能看见且由你指定的未被占据空间，并在法术持续时间内在该处悬浮。占据该空间的守护者除了一把闪光的剑和饰有你守护神标志的盾牌外，其他部位都只是一片模糊。
• 任何与你敌对的生物在一回合内第一次进入守护者身边10尺范围内时必须进行一次敏捷豁免。豁免失败者将受到20点光耀伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。守护者在造成总共60点伤害后随即消失。
target:
• A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers for the duration in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The guardian occupies that space. Apart from a gleaming sword and a shield bearing the symbol of your patron deity, its features are indistinct.
• When a creature hostile to you enters a space within 10 feet of the guardian for the first time on a turn, it must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 20 radiant damage, or half as much on a successful save. The guardian disappears after dealing a total of 60 damage.
note: Retains the hostile-creature entry trigger and cumulative damage limit; no start-of-turn trigger is added.

source:
• 自然之魂回应你的呼唤并将你转变为一个强大的守卫。转变持续到法术结束。你选择以下形态之一取得：原始猛兽或战争巨树。
• 原始猛兽Primal Beast：如野兽般的皮毛覆盖你的身体，你的面部特征变得野性，并且你得到以下增益：
  你的步行速度增加10尺。
  你得到120尺的黑暗视觉。
  你基于力量的攻击检定具有优势。
  你的近战武器攻击在击中时会造成额外1d6力场伤害。
• 战争巨树Great Tree：你的皮肤出现树纹，枝叶从你的头发上萌芽，并且你得到以下增益：
  你得到10点临时生命值。
  你的体质豁免检定具有优势。
  你基于敏捷或基于感知的攻击检定具有优势。
  当你在地面上时，你周围15尺的地面对于你的敌人而言是困难地形。
context: column:M;spell:Guardian of Nature;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:4
target:
• A spirit of nature answers your call and transforms you into a powerful guardian until the spell ends. Choose one of the following forms: Primal Beast or Great Tree.
• Primal Beast: Beastlike fur covers your body, your facial features become feral, and you gain the following benefits:
  Your walking speed increases by 10 feet.
  You gain darkvision with a range of 120 feet.
  You have advantage on Strength-based attack rolls.
  Your melee weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 force damage on a hit.
• Great Tree: Your skin takes on the pattern of tree bark, foliage sprouts from your hair, and you gain the following benefits:
  You gain 10 temporary hit points.
  You have advantage on Constitution saving throws.
  You have advantage on Dexterity-based and Wisdom-based attack rolls.
  While you are on the ground, the ground within 15 feet of you is difficult terrain for your enemies.
note: All four benefits of each form are translated separately, preserving the ground-contact condition and enemy-only terrain effect.

source:
• 你使施法距离内一处150尺立方区域内的自然地形在视觉、听觉、嗅觉上都像是另一种自然地形。因此，开阔的平原或者一条路可能会变得像是一片沼泽，或是丘陵、裂谷以及其他困难地形，甚至是无法通过的地形。一个池塘可能变得看起来像一片草地，一个悬崖像是一个缓坡，或者使一条乱石沟像是一条宽阔平坦的道路。区域内经过加工的建筑、设备或生物的外表不会改变。
• 地形的触觉特征不会改变，所以进入这片区域的生物可能会看穿幻象。如果触觉区别不明显，一个认真调查幻象的生物可以尝试进行一次对抗法术豁免DC的智力（调查）检定以揭穿幻象。对于一个识破了幻象本体的生物，幻象看起来就像是一层模糊的图像叠加在真实地形上。
target:
• You make natural terrain within a 150-foot cube in range look, sound, and smell like another kind of natural terrain. An open plain or road might thus resemble a swamp, hills, a ravine, other difficult terrain, or even impassable terrain. A pond might look like a grassy meadow, a cliff like a gentle slope, or a rocky gully like a broad, level road. Manufactured structures, equipment, and creatures in the area do not change appearance.
• The terrain's tactile properties do not change, so a creature entering the area might see through the illusion. If the difference in touch is not obvious, a creature that carefully examines the illusion can attempt an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC to discern it. To a creature that recognizes the illusion for what it is, it appears as a vague image superimposed on the real terrain.
note: Preserves every terrain example and the distinction between unchanged touch and the conditional Investigation check.

source:
• 以施法距离内一点为中心的一处半径20尺，高40尺的柱状区域内，岩石般坚硬的冰雹重重地砸向地面。每个处在范围内的生物都必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败者将受到2d8点钝击伤害和4d6点冷冻伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。
• 冰雹使风暴影响的区域变为困难地形，直至你的下一回合结束。
• 升环施法效应：使用5环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比4环高一环，钝击伤害就增加1d8。
target:
• Rock-hard hail pounds the ground in a cylinder with a 20-foot radius and a height of 40 feet, centered on a point within range. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 2d8 bludgeoning damage and 4d6 cold damage, or half as much damage on a successful save.
• The hail makes the affected area difficult terrain until the end of your next turn.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a level 5 or higher spell slot, the bludgeoning damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4.
note: Only bludgeoning damage increases with higher slots; the terrain lasts until the end of the caster's next turn.

source:
• 你将一个箱子及其内容物藏在以太位面。你必须同时接触箱子和作为法术材料成分的微缩模型。箱子最多可容纳12立方尺的非活体物质（3尺2尺2尺）。
• 箱子处于以太位面时，你可以用一个动作并触碰箱子的模型来召回箱子。箱子出现在你5尺内一个未被占据空间的地面。随后，你可以使用一个动作并同时触碰箱子与复制品来把箱子送回以太位面。
• 60日之后，法术的效应会每日累计5%的概率自动结束。如果你再次施展该法术或箱子的模型被摧毁，又或者以一个动作终止该法术时，该法术的效应将随之终止。如果法术终止时箱子处于灵界，则其将不可挽回地丢失。
target:
• You hide a chest and its contents on the Ethereal Plane. You must simultaneously touch the chest and the miniature replica used as the spell's material component. The chest can contain up to 12 cubic feet of nonliving material (3 feet by 2 feet by 2 feet).
• While the chest is on the Ethereal Plane, you can use an action and touch its replica to recall it. The chest appears on the ground in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you. You can then use an action and simultaneously touch the chest and its replica to send the chest back to the Ethereal Plane.
• After 60 days, there is a cumulative 5% chance each day that the spell's effect ends automatically. The effect also ends if you cast the spell again, if the replica is destroyed, or if you end the spell as an action. If the chest is in the spirit realm when the spell ends, it is irretrievably lost.
note: The final sentence uses a different source term, rendered spirit realm, from the earlier explicit Ethereal Plane; this discrepancy is retained for review rather than silently unified. The compact source dimensions are expressed as a product without changing their values.

source:
• 你点名或描述一个你熟悉的生物。只要该生物与你相距不超过1000尺，你就会感测到该生物的方位。如果该生物正在移动，则你也将知晓其移动的方向。
• 该法术可以定位一个你认识的特定生物；或者它也可以定位特定的一类生物（例如人类或独角兽）中距你最近个体，不过你需要在30尺的近距离内看到过该类生物至少一次。如果被点名或描述的生物并不处于其原本的形态（例如正被一个变形术 Polymorph的法术效应影响时），则该法术无法定位该生物。
• 如果至少10尺宽的流水横亘于你和被定位生物之间阻挡了二者间的通路，则该生物也无法被该法术所定位。
target:
• Name or describe a creature familiar to you. You sense its direction as long as it is within 1000 feet of you. If the creature is moving, you also know the direction of its movement.
• The spell can locate a particular creature you know, or the nearest creature of a particular kind, such as a human or a unicorn, provided you have seen a creature of that kind at close range, within 30 feet, at least once. If the named or described creature is not in its original form, such as while affected by Polymorph, the spell cannot locate it.
• The spell also cannot locate the creature if running water at least 10 feet wide lies between you and it and blocks the path between you.
note: Retains the prior close-view requirement, transformed-target exception, and running-water width and intervening-path condition.

source:
• 指定施法距离内一处你能看见且未被占据的空间，你在该处创造出一只幻影守护犬。守护犬会在法术持续时间内留在原地，直到你使用一个动作将其解散，或者直到你移动到距它100尺外。
• 除你之外的所有生物视守护犬处于隐形状态，且无法对其造成伤害。当一个小型或更大的生物进入守护犬30尺内时，如果该生物无法说出你在施法时设定的口令，守护犬则会开始大声吠叫。守护犬能看见隐形生物，也可以观察到以太位面，并且无视幻术的影响。
• 在你的每回合开始时，守护犬会尝试啮咬其5尺范围内一个与你敌对的生物。它的攻击加值等于你施法关键属性调整值＋你的熟练加值。若命中，则造成4d8点穿刺伤害。
target:
• Choose an unoccupied space you can see within range. You create a phantom watchdog there. It remains in place for the duration, until you dismiss it as an action, or until you move more than 100 feet away from it.
• The watchdog is invisible to every creature except you, and they cannot harm it. When a Small or larger creature comes within 30 feet of the watchdog, it starts barking loudly unless the creature speaks the password you set when casting the spell. The watchdog can see invisible creatures, can see into the Ethereal Plane, and ignores illusions.
• At the start of each of your turns, the watchdog attempts to bite a creature within 5 feet of it that is hostile to you. Its attack bonus equals your spellcasting ability modifier + your proficiency bonus. On a hit, it deals 4d8 piercing damage.
note: Retains the source's explicit caster-movement distance termination, password exception, and spellcasting-ability-plus-proficiency attack formula.

source:
• 你对施法距离内一片区域施以魔法防护。该区域为一立方区域，其边长小至5尺，大至100尺。该法术一直持续至持续时间结束或施法者以一个动作主动解除。
• 施展该法术时，其生效的保护内容由你决定。在以下几项属性中作选择，你可以选择若干项或者全部选择：
→声音不能穿透被保护区域边缘的障壁
→被保护区域的障壁变得黑暗而模糊，无法通过视觉（包括黑暗视觉）看穿。
→预言法术创造的传感器无法出现在被保护区域内，也无法穿过区域边界处的障壁。
→区域内的生物不能成为预言法术的目标。
→任何事物无法通过传送进出被保护区域。
→在被保护区域内，位面旅行被封锁。
• 每日在同一个位置施展此法术，持续一年，会使这些效果成为永久性效果。
• 升环施法效应：使用5环或更高法术位施展此法术时，你使用的法术位每比4环高一环，你就可以将被保护的立方区域边长增加100尺。比如使用5环法术位时，你就能保护边长至多200尺的立方区域。
target:
• You magically protect an area within range. The area is a cube with a side length from 5 feet to 100 feet. The spell lasts for the duration or until the caster dismisses it as an action.
• When you cast the spell, decide which protections apply. Choose any number or all of the following properties:
→ Sound cannot pass through the barrier at the boundary of the protected area.
→ The barrier around the protected area becomes dark and obscured, preventing sight, including darkvision, through it.
→ Sensors created by divination spells cannot appear inside the protected area or pass through the barrier at its boundary.
→ Creatures in the area cannot be targeted by divination spells.
→ Nothing can teleport into or out of the protected area.
→ Planar travel is blocked within the protected area.
• Casting this spell in the same place every day for a year makes these effects permanent.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a level 5 or higher spell slot, you can increase the protected cube's side length by 100 feet for each slot level above 4. For example, a level 5 spell slot lets you protect a cube with sides up to 200 feet long.
note: All six selectable protections and the permanent-casting requirement remain; no protections are made mandatory.

source:
• 一个微微发光的力场球将施法距离内一个大型或更小的生物或物件封在其中。一个非自愿的生物必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败则该生物在法术持续时间内被关封在球体中。
• 任何事物——包括实体物件、能量或其它法术效应都不能穿透力场球的障壁进出其内，不过生物在球内仍可以正常呼吸。球体免疫一切伤害，且球内的生物或物件不能被来自球外的攻击或效果所伤害，球内的生物也不能对球外的事物造成伤害。
• 该球体没有重量，而其尺寸刚好可以容纳球内的生物或物件。被封住的生物可以使用其动作推动球壁并以该生物速度的一半滚动球体。另外，球体也可以被其他生物拿起或移动。
• 对球体施展解离术 Disintegrate后可以摧毁球体而不伤害球内的任何事物。
• 补充：设计师说明类似任意门、雷霆步这样的【传送】效应可以在力场墙内外进出。
target:
• A sphere of shimmering force encloses a Large or smaller creature or object within range. An unwilling creature must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it is enclosed in the sphere for the duration.
• Nothing, including physical objects, energy, or other spell effects, can pass through the sphere's barrier in either direction, though a creature inside can breathe normally. The sphere is immune to all damage. A creature or object inside cannot be harmed by attacks or effects from outside, and a creature inside cannot harm anything outside.
• The sphere is weightless and just large enough to contain the creature or object inside. An enclosed creature can use its action to push against the sphere's walls and roll it at half that creature's speed. Other creatures can also pick up or move the sphere.
• Casting Disintegrate on the sphere destroys it without harming anything inside.
• Addendum: According to a designer clarification, teleportation effects such as Dimension Door and Thunder Step can move into and out of a Wall of Force.
note: The source's addendum refers to Wall of Force despite this being the sphere spell; the attributed clarification is translated as supplied, not independently verified or silently applied to the sphere.

source:
• 你指定施法距离内一个你能看见的生物，并窥探其噩梦以具象其最深的恐惧，依此创造一个只有目标能看见的幻象化身。目标生物必须进行一次感知豁免。豁免失败时，目标将在法术持续时间内陷入恐慌。在法术终止前，目标必须在其每回合结束时进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败则受4d10点心灵伤害。豁免成功则法术终止。
• 升环施法效应：使用5环或更高的法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比4环高一环，伤害就增加1d10。
target:
• Choose a creature you can see within range. You probe its nightmares and give form to its deepest fear, creating an illusory manifestation visible only to that target. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is frightened for the duration. Until the spell ends, the target must make a Wisdom saving throw at the end of each of its turns, taking 4d10 psychic damage on a failed save. A successful save ends the spell.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a level 5 or higher spell slot, the damage increases by 1d10 for each slot level above 4.
note: Retains the initial fear save and subsequent end-of-turn damage saves as distinct steps; no initial damage is added.

source:
• 该法术将一个施法距离内你能看见的生物变化为一个新的形态。一个非自愿的生物必须进行一次感知豁免来避免此效应。该法术无法对变形生物或生命值为0的生物生效。
• 法术产生的变化在法术持续时间内得以维持，或直至目标的生命值降为0或死亡。新形态可以是任何挑战等级小于等于目标本身的野兽（如果目标没有挑战等级，则以其等级为基准）。目标的游戏资料以及心智相关的属性值都将被所选定野兽的属性数据取代。而其阵营和个性则仍然保留。
• 目标使用其新形态的生命值。当它变回正常形态时，则立即恢复变化前的生命值。如果目标因为生命值降至0而变回正常形态，则其正常形态需要承受所有的溢出伤害。只要溢出的伤害没有将该生物正常形态的生命值降为0，它就不会因打击而陷入昏迷。
• 该生物可作出的动作因其新形态而有所限制。它不能说话，不能施法，也不能作出其他需要用手和需要说话的动作。
• 目标的装备融入新形态中，但其不能启动，使用，挥舞或以其他方式从其装备上获得增益。
target:
• This spell transforms a creature you can see within range into a new form. An unwilling creature must make a Wisdom saving throw to avoid the effect. The spell has no effect on a shapechanger or a creature with 0 hit points.
• The transformation lasts for the duration, or until the target drops to 0 hit points or dies. The new form can be any Beast with a challenge rating no higher than the target's own challenge rating, or its level if it has no challenge rating. The target's game statistics, including its mental ability scores, are replaced by the chosen Beast's statistics. It retains its alignment and personality.
• The target uses its new form's hit points. When it returns to its normal form, it immediately regains the hit points it had before transforming. If it returns to normal because it dropped to 0 hit points, any excess damage carries over to its normal form. As long as that excess damage does not reduce the creature's normal form to 0 hit points, the blow does not knock it unconscious.
• The creature's available actions are limited by its new form. It cannot speak, cast spells, or take other actions that require hands or speech.
• The target's equipment merges into its new form. It cannot activate, use, wield, or otherwise benefit from that equipment.
note: Retains the original hit-point replacement and overflow model, mental-statistic replacement, and all equipment/action restrictions without borrowing a later edition's model.

source:
• 如同火焰般的暗影完全笼罩住你的身体，使你对于其他人处于重度遮蔽，直到法术结束。
• 暗影将你周围10尺内的微光照明转变为黑暗，或者把同样区域的明亮照明转变为微光。直到法术结束之前，你得到对光耀伤害的抗性。此外，不论何时在你周围10尺内的生物用攻击命中你时，暗影会猛击那个生物，对他造成2d8点黯蚀伤害。
context: column:M;spell:Shadow of Moil;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:4
target:
• Flame-like shadows completely shroud your body, making you heavily obscured to others until the spell ends.
• The shadows turn dim light within 10 feet of you into darkness, or bright light in that area into dim light. Until the spell ends, you have resistance to radiant damage. In addition, whenever a creature within 10 feet of you hits you with an attack, the shadows lash out at it, dealing 2d8 necrotic damage.
note: Both light-level changes, radiant resistance, and the attack-hit retaliation are retained.

source:
• 淡绿色的光线以你选择的距离内一点为中心扩散成半径30尺的球体。光线会蔓延过拐角，并一直持续到法术结束。
• 当一个生物在回合内第一次进入法术区域，或者是在其中开始回合，生物必须成功通过一次体质豁免检定，否则将承受4d10光耀伤害和一级力竭，并且会发散出5尺半径的暗绿色光线。这个光线让生物无法从隐形中获益。光线和由于该法术所产生的任何等级的力竭在法术结束时消失。
context: column:M;spell:Sickening Radiance;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:4
target:
• Dim green light spreads from a point you choose within range into a sphere with a 30-foot radius. The light spreads around corners and lasts until the spell ends.
• When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 4d10 radiant damage, gain one level of exhaustion, and shed dark green light in a 5-foot radius. This light prevents the creature from benefiting from invisibility. The light and any levels of exhaustion caused by this spell disappear when the spell ends.
note: Preserves the failed-save branch for damage, exhaustion, and emitted light, and removes only exhaustion caused by this spell when it ends. Independent review adopted by root: place damage, exhaustion, and emitted light together inside the failed-save clause so a successful save does not gain the light effect.

source: • 你在法术持续时间内下一次用近战武器攻击命中某个生物时你的武器将同时贯穿对方的身体与心智。该攻击对目标造成额外4d6点心灵伤害。该目标必须进行一次感知豁免，豁免失败则目标进行攻击检定和属性检定时具有劣势，且不能执行反应直至其下一回合结束。
target: • The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during the spell's duration, your weapon pierces both its body and its mind. The attack deals an extra 4d6 psychic damage to the target. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks and cannot take reactions until the end of its next turn.
note: The damage is not conditional on the saving throw; only the subsequent penalties are.

source: • 你触碰一个体积为中型或更小的石质物件或某块岩石长宽高都不超过5尺的一部分，并将其塑造成你想要的任意形状。比如你可以将一块大石头变成一件武器、一尊塑像、一具棺材，也可以在石墙上开出一条小通道，前提是墙的厚度不能超过5尺。你也可以使一扇石门或石质门框变形来将门封死。你创造的物件最多可以有两条铰链和一道闩，除此之外不能以该法术能塑造出更复杂的机械结构。
target: • You touch a Medium or smaller stone object, or a portion of rock no more than 5 feet in any dimension, and shape it into any form you desire. For example, you could shape a large rock into a weapon, a statue, or a coffin, or make a small passage through a stone wall, provided the wall is no more than 5 feet thick. You can also reshape a stone door or its stone frame to seal the door shut. An object you create can have up to two hinges and a latch, but the spell cannot produce more complex mechanical structures.
note: Preserves every example and the explicit two-hinge, one-latch limit.

source:
• 在距离内，由你指定的一点为中心，出现了一个由强风构成的20尺半径的球体。该球体将在法术的持续时间内持续存在。在球体出现时处于其中的生物，或是在球体内结束其回合的生物均必须通过一次力量豁免检定，否则受到2d6点钝击伤害。球体所在的空间成为困难地形。
• 直到法术终结，你可以在你的每个回合使用一个附赠动作，令球体中心射出一发闪电，攻击距中心不超过60尺范围内的生物。进行一次远程法术攻击，如果攻击目标在球体内，这次攻击检定具有优势。若击中，目标受到4d6点闪电伤害。
• 在球体周围30尺内的生物在用于聆听的感知（观察）检定中具有劣势。
• 升环施法效应：当你使用5环或更高的法术位施放该法术时，使用的法术位每比4环高一环，所有效应产生的伤害便各增加1d6。
context: column:M;spell:Storm Sphere;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:4
target:
• A sphere of strong winds with a 20-foot radius appears, centered on a point you choose within range, and remains for the duration. A creature in the sphere when it appears, or one that ends its turn there, must succeed on a Strength saving throw or take 2d6 bludgeoning damage. The sphere's space is difficult terrain.
• Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to cause a bolt of lightning to shoot from the sphere's center at a creature within 60 feet of that center. Make a ranged spell attack. You have advantage on the attack roll if the target is inside the sphere. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 lightning damage.
• Creatures within 30 feet of the sphere have disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to hear.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a level 5 or higher spell slot, the damage of each of its effects increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 4.
note: Retains both damage effects, the hearing-check penalty, and the higher-slot increase to each effect separately.

source:
• 你从遥远国度或另一个疯狂魔域召来一个灵魄。此灵魄在施法距离内你可见的一个未占据位置化为实体。这一实体使用下面的异怪灵魄Aberrant Spirit的数据。当你施展法术时，从类眼魔Beholderkin，史拉蟾Slaadi或星之子Star Spawn中选择一个。此生物的外形与你所选一致，其资料表中的部分特性也受此影响。当其生命值降到0或法术结束时，生物消失。
• 该生物在法术持续时间内对你和你的同伴们友好。在战斗中，该生物使用你的先攻，但在你回合结束后立即行动。它遵从于你的口头指令（无需任何动作）。如果你不发令，它将执行回避动作并远离危险。
• 升环施法效应：使用5环或更高法术位施展该法术时，该生物数据中使用更高的法术环阶。

异怪灵魄 Aberrant Spirit
中型异怪
AC：11+法术环阶（天生护甲)
HP：40+10每比4环高的法术环阶
速度 30尺，飞行30尺（仅限类眼魔，悬浮）
力量16（+3）  敏捷10（+0）  体质15（+2）
智力16（+3)   感知10（+0）  魅力6（-2）
伤害免疫：心灵
感官：黑暗视觉60尺，被动察觉10
语言：深潜语，懂你说的语言
挑战等级：—
熟练加值：与你相等
再生Regeneration（仅限史拉蟾）。异怪在其自己的回合开始时恢复5点生命值，前提是它至少有1点生命值。
低语灵光Whispering Aura（仅限星之子）。在异怪每个回合的开始时，其5尺内的每个生物必须成功通过一次对抗你的法术豁免DC的感知豁免，否则受到2d6点心灵伤害。
动作
多重攻击Multiattack。异怪发动等同于法术环阶一半的次数的攻击（向下取整）。
爪击Claws（仅限史拉蟾）。近战武器攻击：命中+你的法术攻击调整值，触及5尺，单一目标。伤害：1d10+3+法术环阶点挥砍伤害。如果目标是生物，其直到异怪下回合开始不能恢复生命值。
眼波射线Eye Ray（仅限类眼魔）。远程法术攻击：命中+你的法术攻击调整值，射程30尺，单一生物。伤害：1d8+3+法术环阶点心灵伤害。
灵能猛击Psychic Slam（仅限星之子）。近战法术攻击：命中+你的法术攻击调整值，触及5尺，单一生物。伤害：1d6+3+法术环阶点心灵伤害。
target:
• You summon a spirit from the Far Realm or another realm of madness. It manifests in an unoccupied space you can see within range and uses the Aberrant Spirit statistics below. When you cast the spell, choose Beholderkin, Slaadi, or Star Spawn. The creature resembles the chosen kind, which also determines certain traits in its stat block. It disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends.
• The creature is friendly to you and your companions for the duration. In combat, it shares your initiative but takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands, with no action required. If you give it no commands, it takes the Dodge action and moves away from danger.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a level 5 or higher spell slot, use the higher spell level in the creature's statistics.

Aberrant Spirit
Medium Aberration
AC: 11 + the spell's level (natural armor)
HP: 40 + 10 for each spell level above 4

• Objects come to life at your command. Choose up to ten nonmagical objects within range that are not being held or worn. A Medium target counts as two objects, a Large target as four, and a Huge target as eight; you cannot animate anything larger than Huge. to all of them or to some of them, but you can issue only one kind of command. You decide what action each commanded creature takes and where it moves on its next turn. If it is firmly attached to a surface or a larger object, such as being chained to a wall, its speed is 0. It has blindsight with a range of 30 feet and is blind beyond that range. target:
• Choose an unoccupied space you can see within range. You create a huge, shimmering hand there. It lasts for the duration and moves at your command, mimicking the movements of your own hand.
• The hand is a Large object with AC 20 and hit points equal to your hit point maximum. If it drops to 0 hit points, the spell ends early. Its Strength is 26 (+8), and its Dexterity is 10 (+0). The hand does not occupy its space.

• Forceful Hand: The hand attempts to shove a creature within 5 feet of it. Make a check using the hand's Strength, contested by the target's Strength (Athletics) check. The hand moves with the target, remaining 5 feet from it.
• Grasping Hand: The hand attempts to grapple a Huge or smaller creature within 5 feet of it, using the hand's Strength for the grapple. You have advantage on the check if the target is Medium or smaller. • When a creature enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 5d8 poison damage, or half as much on a successful save. A creature is affected even if it holds its breath or does not need to breathe.
• At the start of each of your turns, the fog moves 10 feet along the ground away from you. It is heavier than air, so it sinks into low areas and even seeps into cracks in the ground.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a level 6 or higher spell slot, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5.
note: Retains the breath-independent effect, strong-wind dispersal, and automatic ground movement away from the caster.

source:
• 你与所信奉神祇或其代理人进行联系，并询问至多三个能以“是”或“否”回答的问题。你必须在法术终止前完成提问，并在随后分别获得每个问题的答案。
• 这些神能存在也并非全知全能，因此当问题涉及的信息超过神祇的认知范围时，你可能会得到一句“不确定”作为回答。另外当一个单词可能引致误导，或者与神祇的兴致相违背时，DM可能会提供一句短语作为答案。
• 若你在两次长休之间两次或更多次的施展该法术，则法术有一定的几率不给任何答复。此概率从第二次施展起每次累计25％。其具体结果由DM暗骰决定。
target:
• You contact your deity or its representative and ask up to three questions that can be answered with yes or no. You must finish asking before the spell ends, and you then receive an answer to each question.
• These divine beings are not all-knowing or all-powerful. You might receive an answer of "Uncertain" if a question concerns information beyond the deity's knowledge. In addition, if a single word would be misleading or contrary to the deity's interests, the DM might provide a short phrase as an answer.
• If you cast this spell two or more times between long rests, there is a chance that it gives no answer. Starting with the second casting, this chance increases cumulatively by 25% each time. The DM rolls secretly to determine the result.
note: The source does not explicitly promise correct answers, so that guarantee is not imported. Its three-question limit, uncertainty, short-phrase option, and cumulative repeat-casting risk are retained.

source:
• 你短暂的成为大自然的一部分并以此获得周围地形的信息。在户外时，该法术可以让你了解3里内大地的状况。在洞穴和其他天然地下场所中，其范围缩小为300 尺半径区域内。自然环境中被建筑覆盖的区域里（比如地下城或城镇中）法术无法生效。
• 你立即获得的自然资讯至多与该地域三个方面的主题相关，在以下项目中进行选择。
→地形和水体
→区域内分布的植物，矿物，动物或人物
→强大的天界生物，精类生物，邪魔，元素生物或者不死生物
→受其他存在位面的影响
→建筑物
• 例如，你可以侦测到某个强大不死生物在区域中的位置，干净安全的水源所在地，以及附近城镇的方位。
target:
• You briefly become part of nature and gain knowledge of the surrounding terrain. Outdoors, the spell gives you knowledge of the land within 3 li. In caves and other natural underground settings, its range is reduced to a 300-foot radius. It does not function where construction has covered the natural environment, such as in dungeons or towns.
• You immediately gain natural knowledge about up to three aspects of the area, chosen from the following:
→ Terrain and bodies of water.
→ Plants, minerals, animals, or people present in the area.
→ Powerful Celestials, Fey, Fiends, Elementals, or Undead.
→ Influence from other planes of existence.
→ Buildings.
• For example, you could learn the location of a powerful undead creature in the area, the location of a safe source of clean water, and the direction of a nearby town.
note: The outdoor distance uses bare li in the source and is retained as li pending unit review. All five information categories and the complete example remain.

source:
• 一片冷空气从你手上迸发而出。在60尺锥状区域内的每个生物必须进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败者将受到8d8点冷冻伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。
• 被该法术杀死的生物将成为一尊冰冻塑像并持续至被解冻。
• 升环施法效应：使用6环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比5环高一环，法术伤害就增加1d8。
target:
• A blast of cold air erupts from your hands. Each creature in a 60-foot cone must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 8d8 cold damage, or half as much on a successful save.
• A creature killed by this spell becomes a frozen statue until it thaws.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a level 6 or higher spell slot, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5.
note: Retains the frozen-statue outcome only for creatures killed by the spell, alongside the full save and higher-slot damage.

source:
• 你召唤出一个元素生物仆从。在施法距离内指定一处充满气、土、火、水四物质其一的10尺立方区域作为法术目标。例如，一只火元素从篝火中成型，而一只土元素则从地面上浮现。一个挑战等级5或者更低的元素生物从目标区域成型，并显现在该区域10尺内一处未被占据空间。该生物在生命值降至0时，或者法术终止时消失不见。
• 被召唤的元素生物对你和你的伙伴保持友善关系。你为召唤出来的元素生物掷先攻权，并依此获得其自己的行动回合。该元素生物服从你发出的所有语言命令（不需要你作动作）。如果你不发出任何命令，该生物会在敌对生物前保护自己，如果没有敌对生物则不执行任何动作。
• 如果你专注被打断，该元素生物并不会因此消失不见，但你会因此失去该元素生物的控制权。失控的元素生物对你和你的伙伴变为敌对，并随时准备发动攻击。不受控的元素生物无法被你解散，并在你的召唤开始算起1小时后消失不见。
• 该元素生物的具体数值由DM掌控。
• 升环施法效应：使用6环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比5环高一环，召唤生物挑战等级就增加1。
target:
• You summon an elemental servant. Choose a 10-foot cube within range filled with air, earth, fire, or water. For example, a Fire Elemental might form from a bonfire, while an Earth Elemental rises from the ground. An Elemental with a challenge rating of 5 or lower forms from that area and appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of it. The creature disappears when it drops to 0 hit points or the spell ends.
• The summoned elemental is friendly to you and your companions. Roll initiative for it; it takes its own turns. It obeys all your verbal commands, with no action required from you. Without commands, it defends itself against hostile creatures and otherwise takes no actions.
• If your concentration is broken, the elemental does not disappear, but you lose control of it. It becomes hostile to you and your companions and is ready to attack. You cannot dismiss an uncontrolled elemental, and it disappears 1 hour after you first summoned it.
• The DM controls the elemental's statistics.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a level 6 or higher spell slot, the summoned creature's challenge rating increases by 1 for each slot level above 5.
note: Retains the separate uncontrolled-elemental exception to disappearance, its hostility, nondismissibility, and expiration measured from the original summoning.

source: • 你向空中用远程武器射出一发非魔法的弹药或者掷出一把非魔法的投掷武器，并指定施法距离内一点，随后，无数以所发射弹药或武器为原型的复制体向该点倾盆而下，并在完成攻击后消失不见。箭雨充斥以目标点为中心半径40尺，高20尺的柱状区域，其内的每个生物都必须进行一次敏捷豁免，豁免失败者将受到8d8点伤害，豁免成功则伤害减半。法术所造成伤害的类型与用作法术成分材料的弹药或武器相同。
target: • You fire a piece of nonmagical ammunition into the air with a ranged weapon or throw a nonmagical thrown weapon, then choose a point within range. Countless copies of that ammunition or weapon rain down around the point and disappear after the attack. The volley fills a cylinder centered on the point with a 40-foot radius and a height of 20 feet. Each creature in the cylinder must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 8d8 damage, or half as much on a successful save. The damage is the same type as that dealt by the ammunition or weapon used as the spell's material component.
note: Retains both material options and their damage-type dependency; no default damage type is introduced.

source:
• 你与一名半神，或者一个古老的贤者亡魂，又或是其他异位面的神秘实体建立了精神的连接。与这些跨位面亚种生物进行的知性接触可能会增加你的精神负担，甚至导致精神崩溃。当你施展此法术时，进行一个DC15的智力豁免。豁免失败时，你受到6d6点心灵伤害并因此而变得错乱，直至完成一个长休以结束该状态。处于错乱状态时，你不能执行动作，不能理解其他生物说的话也无法阅读，你说出口的也都是一些含糊不清的语句。对你施放法术高等复原术 Greater Restoration可以直接终止该效应。
• 豁免成功时，你可以询问该实体五个问题。你必须在法术结束前提出你的问题。而你所提出的每条问题DM都可以用一个单词作回答，比如“是”“不是”“可能”“不可能”“没关系”或是“不清楚”（如果该实体不知道该问题答案时）。如果一个单词的答案可能导致误导，DM可能会用一句短语来作为问题的答案。
target:
• You establish a mental connection with a demigod, the spirit of an ancient sage, or another mysterious extraplanar entity. Intellectual contact with such a being can strain your mind or even cause a mental breakdown. When you cast the spell, make a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, you take 6d6 psychic damage and become mentally deranged until you finish a long rest. While in this state, you cannot take actions, understand other creatures' speech, or read, and your own speech consists of incoherent phrases. Casting Greater Restoration on you ends the effect immediately.
• On a successful save, you can ask the entity five questions. You must ask them before the spell ends. The DM can answer each with a single word, such as "Yes," "No," "Maybe," "Impossible," "Irrelevant," or "Unclear" if the entity does not know the answer. If a single word would be misleading, the DM might answer with a short phrase.
note: Retains all consequences of the failed save and the five-question successful-save branch. The source describes an unnamed state of mental derangement; it is not replaced by another named condition.

source:
• 你的触碰带着疾病。你对触及范围内一个生物发动一次近战法术攻击。若命中，则该目标中毒。
• 该中毒目标的每一回合结束时，必须进行一次体质豁免。若该目标累计三次该豁免成功，则其不再中毒且该法术终止。若该目标累计三次该豁免失败，其亦不再中毒，但必须从以下描述的疾病中选择其一。随后该目标将受选定的疾病影响直至该法术持续时间结束。
• 由于法术对目标引发的是自然疾病，因此任何移除疾病或改善疾病状况的效应都可以对受术生物产生影响。
失明症Blinding Sickness。 痛苦缠绕着患病者的意志，并使其眼睛变成奶白色。患病生物进行感知检定和感知豁免时具有劣势，并且承受目盲状态。
腐热症Filth Fever。 患者身体发起严重的高烧。患病生物进行力量检定和力量豁免时，以及发动基于力量的攻击检定时具有劣势。
烂肉症Flesh Rot。 患者的肌肤逐渐腐朽。患病生物进行魅力检定时具有劣势，并且具有所有伤害类型的伤害易受。
脑热症Mindfire。患者头脑发热。患病生物进行智力检定和智力豁免时具有劣势，并且其在战斗中视为受到困惑术 confusion效应影响。
癫痫症Seizure。患者全身颤抖不止。患病生物进行敏捷检定和敏捷豁免时，以及发动基于敏捷的攻击检定时具劣势。
恶心症Slimy Doom。 患者开始不受控地流血。患病生物进行体质检定和体质豁免时具有劣势。另外每当该生物受到伤害时都会陷入震慑状态，直至其下一回合结束。
target:
• Your touch carries disease. Make a melee spell attack against a creature within your reach. On a hit, the target is poisoned.
• At the end of each of the poisoned target's turns, it must make a Constitution saving throw. If it accumulates three successful saves, it is no longer poisoned and the spell ends. If it accumulates three failed saves, it is also no longer poisoned, but one of the diseases described below must be chosen. The target then suffers from that disease for the remainder of the spell's duration.
• Because the spell causes a natural disease, any effect that removes a disease or improves its symptoms can affect the target.
Blinding Sickness. Pain grips the victim's mind and turns its eyes milky white. The diseased creature has disadvantage on Wisdom checks and Wisdom saving throws and is blinded.
Filth Fever. A severe fever sweeps through the victim's body. The diseased creature has disadvantage on Strength checks, Strength saving throws, and Strength-based attack rolls.
Flesh Rot. The victim's flesh decays. The diseased creature has disadvantage on Charisma checks and vulnerability to all damage types.
Mindfire. The victim's mind becomes feverish. The diseased creature has disadvantage on Intelligence checks and Intelligence saving throws and is treated as being affected by Confusion in combat.
Seizure. The victim shakes uncontrollably. The diseased creature has disadvantage on Dexterity checks, Dexterity saving throws, and Dexterity-based attack rolls.
Slimy Doom. The victim begins bleeding uncontrollably. The diseased creature has disadvantage on Constitution checks and Constitution saving throws. In addition, whenever it takes damage, it is stunned until the end of its next turn.
note: All six diseases and the accumulated three-success or three-failure process are retained. The source's disease-selection subject is unclear; the translation leaves the chooser unspecified instead of assigning a new right to the caster or target.

source:
• 你获得对距离内，你可以看见的，100立方尺的空气的操控能力。当施放此法术时，选择下述效果之一。该效果将在法术的持续时间内始终生效，除非你在稍后的回合中使用一个动作来调整为其他的效果。你也可以使用你的动作来暂停效应或重启一个被暂停的效应。
• 狂风Gusts：你操控的空气中产生了一阵狂风，持续的向一个由你选择的水平方向吹去。你选择风力的强度：微风calm，大风moderate和强风strong。若风力为大风或强风，进入或者离开区域，或者是穿过其中的远程武器攻击在其攻击检定中得到劣势。若风力为强风，逆风而行的生物每移动1尺需要额外消耗1尺的移动力。
• 下沉气流Downdraft：你操控的空气产生了向下的气流，从空间的顶部开始下沉。穿过其中的远程武器攻击，或是对于处于其中的生物进行的远程武器攻击在其攻击检定中得到劣势。生物每回合第一次飞进受影响的空间，或是在飞行状态下于受影响的空间开始其回合，其必须进行一次力量豁免检定。若检定失败，该生物摔落倒地。
• 上升气流Updraft：你操控的空气产生了向上的气流，从空间的底部开始上升。在该空间内结束摔落的生物只会因为该摔落受到一半的伤害。处于该空间内的生物垂直跳跃时，其能比正常情况下跳跃的高度高出10尺。
context: column:M;spell:Control Wind;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:5
target:
• You gain control of 100 cubic feet of air you can see within range. When you cast the spell, choose one of the effects below. It lasts for the duration unless you use an action on a later turn to change to another effect. You can also use your action to pause the effect or restart a paused effect.
• Gusts: A wind arises in the air you control, blowing continuously in a horizontal direction of your choice. Choose its strength: calm, moderate, or strong. If it is moderate or strong, ranged weapon attacks entering, leaving, or passing through the area have disadvantage on their attack rolls. If it is strong, a creature moving against the wind must spend 1 additional foot of movement for every 1 foot it moves.
• Downdraft: The air you control produces a downward current from the top of the space. Ranged weapon attacks passing through the area or targeting creatures in it have disadvantage on their attack rolls. When a creature flies into the affected space for the first time on a turn or starts its turn flying there, it must make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it falls to the ground and lands prone.
• Updraft: The air you control produces an upward current from the bottom of the space. A creature that ends a fall in the space takes only half the damage from that fall. A creature in the space can jump 10 feet higher than normal when making a vertical jump.
note: The source explicitly gives 100 cubic feet, not a cube with 100-foot sides; this volume is preserved. The source's calm/moderate/strong English labels are used, and all pause, restart, attack, movement, fall, and jump rules remain.

source:
• 你从堕影冥界取来一些暗影物质，并在施法距离内创造一个非活体的物件。你可以创造一个植物质（类似纺织品、绳索、木质等）的物件。也可以创造一个矿物质（类似石质、水晶、金属等）的物件。创造出来的物件大小必需在5尺立方内，且其形态与材质你必需曾经见过。
• 法术的持续时间由所创造物件的材质决定。如果所创造物件由多种材质组合而成，则其存在时间取其中最短者。
材质                       持续时间
植物质vegetable matter      1日
石质stone或水晶crystal      12小时
贵金属precious metals       1小时
宝石gems                    10分钟
精金adamantine或秘银mithral 1分钟
• 施展其他法术时，如果以这些创造物作为其材料成分将会使该法术施法失败。
• 升环施法效应：使用6环或更高法术位施展该法术时，你使用的法术位每比5环高一环，创造物尺寸的立方边长就加大5尺。
target:
• You draw shadow substance from the Shadowfell and create a nonliving object within range. You can create an object made of vegetable matter, such as fabric, rope, or wood, or of mineral matter, such as stone, crystal, or metal. The object must fit within a 5-foot cube, and its form and material must be ones you have seen before.
• The spell's duration depends on the object's material. If it combines several materials, use the shortest applicable duration.
Material | Duration
Vegetable matter | 1 day
Stone or crystal | 12 hours
Precious metals | 1 hour
Gems | 10 minutes
Adamantine or mithral | 1 minute
• Using any of these created objects as a material component for another spell causes that spell to fail.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a level 6 or higher spell slot, the side length of the cube that can contain the created object increases by 5 feet for each slot level above 5.
note: All five duration-table rows, mixed-material shortest-duration rule, component failure, and cube-side scaling are retained.

source:
• 黑暗力量的线从你的指尖延伸，刺穿了法术距离内最多5具你可见的小型Small或中型Medium的尸体。每具尸体都立即站起变为亡灵。你自由决定它是僵尸zombie或者骷髅skeleton（僵尸和骷髅的数据参考怪物手册），并且它们在攻击和伤害检定中得到等同你的施法属性调整值的加值。
• 你可以用你的附赠动作精神性地指挥你用该法术创造的生物，并对它们发出同样的命令。生物必须在你60尺内才能接受命令。你决定被操纵的生物下回合的动作和移动。或者，你可以下达宽泛的命令，例如守护某个房间或走廊。如果你不下达命令，生物只会保护自己对抗敌对生物。一旦被下达命令，生物会持续执行命令直到任务完成。
• 你对这些生物的控制持续到法术结束，在那之后它们立即变回无生命状态。
• 升环施法效应：当你使用6环或更高的法术位施放该法术时，使用的法术位每比5环高一环，你就可以活化额外的两具尸体。
context: column:M;spell:Danse Macabre;book:珊娜萨的万事指南;level:5
target:
• Threads of dark power extend from your fingertips and pierce up to 5 Small or Medium corpses you can see within range. Each corpse immediately rises as an undead creature. You choose whether each is a Zombie or Skeleton; use their statistics from the Monster Manual. They gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to your spellcasting ability modifier.
• As a bonus action, you can mentally command the creatures you created with this spell, giving them the same command. A creature must be within 60 feet of you to receive a command. You decide its action and movement on its next turn, or give a general command such as guarding a room or corridor. Without commands, a creature only defends itself against hostile creatures. Once given a command, it continues until the task is complete.
• Your control lasts until the spell ends, after which the creatures immediately become lifeless again.
• At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a level 6 or higher spell slot, you can animate two additional corpses for each slot level above 5.
note: Retains the attack-and-damage modifier bonus, same-command restriction, command reception distance, and immediate return to lifelessness.

source:
• 拂晓之光落在施法距离内你指定的地点，形成一道30尺半径、40尺高度的明亮光柱。这个光芒被视为阳光。
• 当光柱出现时，每个处于其中的生物都必须进行体质豁免，失败将受到4d10光耀伤害，成功则只承受一半。在光柱中结束回合的生物也必须再次进行这个豁免。
• 如果你在光柱60尺内，你可以在你的回合以一个附赠动作将它移动60尺。
target:
• The light of dawn shines down at a point you choose within range, forming a cylinder of bright light with a 30-foot radius and a height of 40 feet. This light counts as sunlight.
• When the cylinder appears, each creature in it must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 4d10 radiant damage on a failed save or half as much on a successful save. A creature that ends its turn in the cylinder must also make this save again.
• If you are within 60 feet of the cylinder, you can use a bonus action on your turn to move it 60 feet.
note: Preserves the source's movement wording of 60 feet without inserting an unstated up-to qualifier, and retains both saving-throw triggers and sunlight status.

source: • 你击打地面，并从身上爆发出一阵神圣能量。30尺范围内每个你所指定的生物都必须进行一次体质豁免。豁免失败者将受到5d6点雷鸣伤害以及5d6点光耀或黯蚀伤害（由你选择）并应击倒地，豁免成功则伤害减半且不会应击倒地。
target: • You strike the ground, releasing a burst of divine energy. Each creature you choose within 30 feet must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 5d6 thunder damage and 5d6 radiant or necrotic damage, your choice, and is knocked prone. On a successful save, it takes half as much damage and is not knocked prone.
note: The second damage type is the caster's choice; being knocked prone remains confined to the failed-save branch.
